description_en: Retrieves the data batch ingestion configuration
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-data-batch-ingestion --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDataBatchIngestion

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: The assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.

Note: Although this parameter is marked as optional, it is actually required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns a 400 error
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。

注意：该参数虽标记为可选，但实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 400 错误
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

items.description_en: The cloud native mode ingestion ID

Indicates whether new users are automatically discovered. Valid values:

disabled: Disabled

DataBatchIngestionEffectTime.description_en: The effective period of the data batch ingestion. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds

DataBatchIngestionSetTime.description_en: The time when the data batch ingestion was configured. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
DataBatchIngestionSetTime.description_zh: 数据批量接入设置时间。Unix时间戳，单位：毫秒

running: In effect.

running：生效中。
success：生效成功。
failed：生效失败
